lessons.title: Learning Performance Lines
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to say their performance lines clearly and with expression.
success_criteria: I can say my line clearly.
I can add expression to my line.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model saying a line clearly with expression, contrasting flat vs expressive delivery.
lessons.independent_task: Children practise their individual/group performance lines with adult support.
key_questions: Can you say your line clearly?
How could you add more expression?

differentiation.support: Simplify line to a short phrase

lessons.assessment_notes: Note speech clarity and expression — evidence for ENG.SL1.
lessons.home_link: Practise saying your line clearly at home.

lessons.title: Time for the Performance: Reading a Schedule
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to read times on the performance day schedule.
success_criteria: I can read a time on the schedule.
I can say what happens at that time.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap o'clock and half past times.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model reading a simple performance day schedule with times.
lessons.independent_task: Children read and answer questions about the performance day schedule.
key_questions: What time does the performance start?
What happens at 2 o'clock?
lessons.assessment_notes: Record time-telling applied to a real context — evidence for MATHS.MEA.
lessons.home_link: Read a schedule or timetable together at home.

lessons.title: Finishing Performance Costumes/Props
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to complete their performance costume or prop.
success_criteria: I can finish my costume/prop.
I can explain its purpose.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap costume/prop work from last week.
lessons.independent_task: Children complete final touches on their costume/prop.
key_questions: Is your costume/prop finished?
What is it for?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note completion of a design-to-product process — evidence for ART.1.
lessons.plenary: Try on/show costumes and props together.
lessons.home_link: Show your costume/prop to your family.

lessons.title: Full Run-Through Rehearsal
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to perform their part in sequence with the whole group.
success_criteria: I can say my line at the right time.
I can follow the performance sequence.
lessons.starter_activity: Warm up voices with a vocal exercise.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model listening for cues and following the performance sequence.
lessons.independent_task: Full run-through of the performance from start to finish.
key_questions: What is your cue?
What part are you most confident with?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note performance confidence and sequence recall — evidence for ENG.SL1.
lessons.home_link: Practise your part of the performance at home.

lessons.title: Counting the Audience: Tally and Total
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to use tallying to count and total a group.
success_criteria: I can tally a count.
I can find the total.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model tallying a pretend audience count and finding the total.
lessons.independent_task: Children practise tallying and totalling different pretend audience group sizes.
key_questions: How many people is that tally?
What is the total?

differentiation.greater_depth: Tally and total larger groups independently

lessons.assessment_notes: Record tallying and totalling skill recap — evidence for MATHS.N1.
lessons.home_link: Tally something at home (e.g. cars passing, family members' shoe colours).

lessons.title: Stage Backdrop Art
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to contribute to a class backdrop for the performance.
success_criteria: I can paint/draw part of the backdrop.
I can work carefully alongside others.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model contributing carefully to a large collaborative artwork.
lessons.independent_task: Children contribute to painting/decorating the class performance backdrop.
key_questions: What part are you working on?
How are you working together?

differentiation.greater_depth: Take initiative adding detail to the whole backdrop

lessons.assessment_notes: Observe collaborative art skill — evidence for ART.1/PSHE links.
lessons.home_link: Talk about working together on a project at home.

lessons.title: Phonics: Consolidation Before the Break
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to blend and read a range of words fluently.
success_criteria: I can blend and read words.
I can read a short sentence fluently.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap all graphemes covered this half-term.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Consolidation session covering graphemes taught this half-term.
lessons.independent_task: Children read a range of word and sentence cards, with fluency noted.
key_questions: Can you read this word?
Can you read this sentence fluently?
lessons.assessment_notes: Half-term phonics consolidation check — evidence for ENG.R1.

lessons.title: Autumn Term Maths Recap Game
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to demonstrate progress across the term's key maths skills in a celebratory game.
success_criteria: I can use addition and subtraction confidently.
I can use shape, measure and fraction knowledge.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap key maths learning from across the autumn term.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Play a whole-term recap game/board game combining number, shape, measure and fraction questions.
lessons.independent_task: Children play the recap game in small groups.
resources_needed: Term recap board game or station resources
key_questions: What have you learned this term in maths?
What are you most proud of?
lessons.assessment_notes: Summarise Autumn term maths progress overall — evidence across MATHS.N1/N2/N3/N4/MEA/GEO for the term.
lessons.plenary: Celebrate everyone's maths progress this term.
lessons.home_link: Practise favourite maths games together over the holidays.

lessons.title: Dress Rehearsal
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to perform in full costume with confidence.
success_criteria: I can wear my costume correctly.
I can perform my part confidently.
lessons.starter_activity: Get into costume and warm up together.
lessons.independent_task: Full dress rehearsal in costume, with a small audience (another class) if possible.
key_questions: How does it feel performing in costume?
What went well today?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note performance readiness — evidence for ART.1/ENG.SL1 combined.
lessons.home_link: Show family your costume before the big performance.

lessons.title: Calming Performance Nerves
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to use a strategy to manage performance nerves.
success_criteria: I can name a calming strategy.
I can use it before performing.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss that feeling nervous before a performance is normal.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Introduce simple calming strategies (deep breaths, positive self-talk).
lessons.independent_task: Children practise using a calming strategy before a final rehearsal.
key_questions: Do you feel nervous or excited?
What could help you feel calmer?

differentiation.greater_depth: Lead the strategy for the group

lessons.assessment_notes: Note emerging self-regulation strategy use — evidence for ENG.SL1/PSHE links.
lessons.home_link: Practise the calming strategy together before the performance.

lessons.title: Autumn Term Assessment Recap
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to demonstrate their overall number skills built this term.
success_criteria: I can add and subtract within 20.
I can use place value confidently.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap key number learning from the term.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Mixed final assessment activity covering number skills from the term.
lessons.independent_task: Children complete a final number assessment activity.
key_questions: How confident do you feel with number?
What would you like to improve?
lessons.assessment_notes: Final autumn term number assessment for each child — evidence for MATHS.N1/N2.
lessons.home_link: Practise number skills over the holidays.

lessons.title: Final Performance Preparations
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to make final preparations for the performance.
success_criteria: I can check my costume/prop is ready.
I can feel confident about my part.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap all elements of the performance.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Final checks discussion for costumes, props, and backdrop.
lessons.independent_task: Children complete final preparations and a final quiet run-through of their lines/actions.
key_questions: Is everything ready?
How are you feeling about tomorrow?

differentiation.greater_depth: Help check others are ready too

lessons.assessment_notes: Final readiness check before the performance — evidence for ART.1/ENG.SL1.
lessons.plenary: Recap feeling ready for the big day.
lessons.home_link: Get a good night's sleep ready for the performance!

lessons.title: The Christmas Performance
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to perform their part confidently in front of an audience.
success_criteria: I can say my line/perform my part confidently.
I can enjoy the performance.
lessons.starter_activity: Final warm-up of voices and a calming breath together.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Final brief pep talk before the performance.
lessons.independent_task: The class performs the Christmas performance for parents/carers or another audience.
resources_needed: Full costumes/props, backdrop, music, performance space
key_questions: How did it feel to perform?
What was your favourite part?

differentiation.support: Adult provides reassurance and prompts as needed
differentiation.greater_depth: Perform independently with full confidence and expression

lessons.assessment_notes: Final spoken language and confidence assessment for the term — evidence for ENG.SL1, summarising progress since Week 1.
lessons.plenary: Celebrate the completed performance with the whole class.
lessons.home_link: Celebrate your performance with your family!

lessons.title: Autumn Term Maths Celebration
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to reflect on their maths achievements this term.
success_criteria: I can say what I'm proud of in maths.
I can say what I want to improve next term.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the whole autumn term's maths learning.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Discuss reflecting on achievements and setting a goal for spring term.
lessons.independent_task: Children complete a maths reflection activity.
key_questions: What maths are you proud of this term?
What is your goal for next term?
lessons.assessment_notes: Autumn term maths progress summary for each child — evidence across all MATHS objectives covered this term.
lessons.plenary: Big maths celebration for the term.
lessons.home_link: Celebrate your maths progress with your family over the holidays.

lessons.title: Autumn Term Celebration and Reflection
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to reflect on their achievements across the whole autumn term.
success_criteria: I can name a favourite moment from this term.
I can say what I'm proud of.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap key moments from across the whole autumn term (toys, fire safety, London, Christmas).
lessons.main_teaching_input: Discuss reflecting on the whole term's achievements.
lessons.independent_task: Children share their proudest moment or achievement from the whole term, contributing to a 'Look How Far We've Come' display.
resources_needed: Photos/work samples from across the term
key_questions: What are you most proud of from this term?
How have you grown since September?

differentiation.support: Point to a photo and share simply
differentiation.greater_depth: Explain growth and achievement in detail

lessons.assessment_notes: Note reflective language and term-long progress overview — evidence for ART.1/PSHE, summarising the whole of Autumn 1 and 2.
lessons.plenary: Whole-class celebration of a fantastic first term in Year 1.
lessons.home_link: Share your proudest moment from this term with your family over the holidays.
